title: Inverse Anchor
technique_dna:
caption break|noise gating|delay loop|sorter|unfinished return|repeats altered start|glitched-cool|inverse-anchor

↺ Notice → Shift → Release → Loop
ritual_text:
Pick the most urgent image. Begin inside "Inverse Anchor".
Do not answer it yet.
Count the space before meaning hardens.
Lengthen that space deliberately.
Urgency weakens when it cannot become language quickly.
Save only what survives the delay #93.
Let the rest lose permission.
Trust the piece that stays cool.
Name it once and let it flicker.
Then bring image back and delay it again through "Inverse Anchor".
Stop just before "Inverse Anchor" resolves, and let the remaining flicker pull the next pass forward.

title: Sidelong Anchor
technique_dna:
static cue|signal isolation|flicker return|observer|immediate re-entry|returns to opening cue|glitched-cool|sidelong-anchor

↺ Catch → Tilt → Dissolve → Repeat
ritual_text:
Do not correct thought. Begin inside "Sidelong Anchor".
Let it arrive unfinished.
Notice the shimmer around its edges.
Attend to the side-noise, not the headline.
The center is often a decoy.
Choose one colder word for the pattern #94.
Hold that word without closing it.
Let the static reveal the truest fragment, slowly.
Keep the fragment alive through noise.
Then return to thought and meet only its shimmer through "Sidelong Anchor".
Stop just before "Sidelong Anchor" resolves, and let the remaining flicker pull the next pass forward.
